answer: To unlock payout, an agent locks a bond equal to 60 days of median fees and, over a 21-day window, settles three invoices with disjoint counterparties. Four established, non-kin attestors may countersign only by citing those invoice txids and posting their own stake against a false voucher. A public atlas records every bond, voucher, and slash. If a sibling key is later linked to the same operator, all related bonds are forfeited, so a manufactured island of clones cannot cash a second pearl of epoch rewards.
